description: Database schema: create RLHFFeedback SQLAlchemy model, register it in models/__init__.py, create Pydantic schemas in backend/app/schemas/rlhf.py, and write the Alembic migration file. No UNIQUE(user_id, outfit_id) constraint. items_liked/items_disliked stored as JSON Text columns via TypeDecorator.
steps: Create backend/app/models/rlhf_feedback.py: define RLHFFeedback class inheriting Base. Columns: id (UUID PK), user_id (UUID FK→users.id CASCADE), outfit_id (UUID FK→outfits.id CASCADE), rating (Integer CHECK 1-5), comment (Text nullable), items_liked (Text via JSONListTypeDecorator, default '[]'), items_disliked (Text via JSONListTypeDecorator, default '[]'), occasion_matched (Boolean nullable), seasonal_appropriate (Boolean nullable), created_at (DateTime timezone=True server_default=func.now()), updated_at (DateTime timezone=True server_default=func.now() onupdate=func.now()). Add two indexes: idx_rlhf_user_created on (user_id, created_at DESC) and idx_rlhf_outfit_rating on (outfit_id, rating DESC). NO UniqueConstraint on (user_id, outfit_id). Add JSONListTypeDecorator inner class (impl=Text, cache_ok=True) that json.dumps list[dict] on write and json.loads on read.
Edit backend/app/models/__init__.py: add 'from app.models.rlhf_feedback import RLHFFeedback' import and add 'RLHFFeedback' to the __all__ list.

Create backend/app/schemas/rlhf.py: define RLHFFeedbackRequest (outfit_id: uuid.UUID, rating: int Field(ge=1, le=5), comment: str|None max_length=500, items_liked: list[dict]=[], items_disliked: list[dict]=[], occasion_matched: bool|None, seasonal_appropriate: bool|None). Define RLHFFeedbackResponse (id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID, outfit_id: uuid.UUID, rating: int, created_at: datetime, is_new: bool, total_feedbacks_by_user: int, pairs_available: int). Define RLHFStatsDayPoint (date: str, avg_rating: float, count: int). Define RLHFStats (total_feedbacks: int, average_rating: float, rating_distribution: dict[int,int], recent_feedbacks: list[dict], most_liked_items: list[dict], most_disliked_items: list[dict], avg_rating_trend: list[RLHFStatsDayPoint], most_liked_occasions: dict[str,float], readiness_for_training: dict). Add model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) to response models.
